title: UI: Onion skin controls in timeline
description: Add onion skin toggle and range controls to the timeline toolbar in Shell.tsx. Flash 8 has: onion skin on/off button, onion skin outlines button, always show markers, edit multiple frames. Show 2 frames before and after by default. Wire to existing getOnionSkinFrames in packages/core/src/engine/onionskin.ts and the StageArea onion skin rendering.
